label: Movement
tooltip: Mounts, sprinting and getting unstuck. Used by every mode.

should_auto_mount.label: Mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip:
On: mount for long trips, and get back on if you are knocked off.
Off: stay on foot.

should_jump_when_stuck.label: Jump when stuck
should_jump_when_stuck.tooltip: Jump when you are stuck on a rock, ledge or stairs.

prefer_return_over_shard_walk.label: Use Return instead of walking to a shard
prefer_return_over_shard_walk.tooltip:
On: for long trips, use Return to camp when it is ready, so you don't walk past enemies to reach a shard.
Off: take whichever route is shortest.
